name: IPTCデータ検証
description: 検証します IPTC (International Press Telecommunications Council) メタデータ fields for 真正性 markers, digital source type classification, and AI tool signatures in professional photo workflows.
algorithm: IPTCフィールド真正性アナライザー
mechanism:
The IPTC verification examines professional メタデータ layers:

1. **DigitalSourceType Classification**: チェックします ISO 12639 DigitalSourceType field for non-photographic indicators などの 'trainedAlgorithmicMedia', 'algorithmicMedia', 'virtualRecording', or 'compositeSynthetic'.

2. **Authenticity Field Count**: Counts professional IPTC fields (credit, source, copyright, writer, caption, byline, city, country, headline, keywords). High field count indicates professional photographic workflow.

3. **AI Reference Detection**: Scans IPTC values for references to AI tools (Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Midjourney, etc.) in source, credit, and software fields.

4. **Workflow Validation**: Validates that IPTC メタデータ follows professional photography conventions — wire services, stock agencies, and newsrooms embed rich IPTC data.
parameters:
IPTC 真正性 fields: credit, source, copyright, writer, caption, byline, city, country, headline, keywords, instructions, category
DigitalSourceType values: photographicImage, negativeFilm, positiveFilm, trainedAlgorithmicMedia, algorithmicMedia, virtualRecording
ISO 12639 classifications
accuracy: 高 - 85%+ for professional news/stock photos with IPTC data. Limited for consumer photos は rarely include IPTC.
useCase: Professional photo verification: validates images from news agencies, stock photo services, and professional photographers. The presence of comprehensive IPTC メタデータ strongly indicates professional origin.
strengths:
• DigitalSourceTypeが存在すれば明示的なAI宣言
• プロ写真はAIが複製できない豊富なIPTCデータを持つ
• 主要通信社が使用する業界標準
• IPTCソースフィールドから特定のAIツールを識別
• DigitalSourceTypeでのゼロ偽陽性
limitations:
• 消費者写真にはIPTCが含まれることが稀
• IPTCフィールドは手動で偽造可能
• 多くのAIサービスがDigitalSourceTypeを未設定
• SNSがIPTCを削除
• IPTCの不在はAI生成を示さない
